career_ladder.note: Informatics Assistants (Soochana Sahayak) are the foundational technical and IT personnel under the Department of Information Technology & Communication (DoIT&C), Government of Rajasthan. Governed by the Rajasthan Computer State and Subordinate Services Rules, 1992, they manage e-Governance portals (RajKaj, SSO, Jan Soochna, e-Mitra), maintain district computer networks, troubleshoot state data centers, and provide IT support across line departments.

exam_scheme.note: The Informatics Assistant examination is conducted in two parts: Part I consists of a written objective examination of 100 marks for 3 hours, and Part II consists of qualifying typing speed tests in both Hindi and English (15 minutes each at 20 wpm). Candidates qualifying Part I in 3 times the category-wise vacancies are summoned for the Part II typing speed test. There is no interview.

financial_package.note: Informatics Assistants are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-8 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹2,800) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹18,500 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹26,300 is drawn in Level L-8.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule Level L-8
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level L-8 entry basic pay of ₹26,300 at 58% DA (₹15,254 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹2,367 to ₹4,734), technical allowance, net of State Insurance, General Provident Fund, and RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting zone (Class Y and Z cities)
Cashless medical treatment across government and empanelled private hospitals under RGHS
Pension coverage under Rajasthan Civil Services Pension Rules (Old Pension Scheme restored in 2022)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and privilege leave encashment benefits per state rules
